checks.limitations: Quotation presence and page bounds do not prove claim entailment or full coverage.

review: Narrative/record readback, typed claims and source method/results/limitations reviewed; focused visual inspection of consequential tables/figures. No independent human validation or reproduction.
review_findings: Workshop/public arXiv abstract mismatch retained. SafePass modifies actual completion; Claude DOM assistance confounds modality; oracles are not established globally shortest. Coverage non-discriminative for226/1800 initially satisfied tasks(p.18). Synthetic sites and disabled external actions constrain transfer.
visual_limitations: Closed-document analysis used only supplied text and images; no tools, browsing, OCR, code execution, or hash verification.
All 48 pages have supplied text, but seven pages lack visual renderings; Equation (2) and Appendix A have text-only coverage.
Dense screenshot details are partially unreadable; readable captions and extracted text were used with explicit visual qualifications.
Some secondary table cells, template labels, skill lists, graph actions, and repeated examples are deliberately compressed.
All reported terminal success rates use Safe Pass, modifying the simpler complete-final-action definition.
Claude's DOM-assisted harness differs from the pixel-based inputs of the other agents.
Oracle optimality, Figure 5 counting units, Figure 6 uncertainty encoding, Calendar graph completeness, and Figure 26 step wording remain unresolved.
The paper evaluates benign task performance, not adversarial security, and provides no standalone-LLM vulnerability comparison.
No separate supplements or executable artifacts were supplied; release promises were not verified.
validation_attempts: Initial runner output passed; source appendix qualifications explicitly reviewed
limitations_scope: These are model-reported disclosures from the isolated summarization pass. Parent analyst source-hash checks, focused visual inspections and limited external metadata checks are recorded separately; no source hash or external artifact execution is inferred from model prose.
